//BEEM: Beem Africa OTP phone verification for first-time registration (see BEEM_OTP_INTEGRATION.md). BEEM_OTP_APP_ID is the OTP Application ID from the Beem dashboard (OTP > Applications) — not secret; the deployed value lives in functions/.env (copy .env.example -> .env) and no Dart code reads it (the app just calls the sendBeemOtp/verifyBeemOtp/consumeOtpVerification callables). BEEM_API_KEY / BEEM_SECRET_KEY are Secret Manager secrets (firebase functions:secrets:set) and must NEVER be added here: dart-define values are compiled into the app binary.
